faq.q: What is the main difference between Astondoa 40 and Sunseeker Predator 55 in Marbella?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 is a 12.5m sport cruiser for up to 9 guests, priced at €749 for 2 hours. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a 16.8m flybridge model for up to 12 guests, with pricing on request. The Astondoa offers better value for smaller groups, while the Sunseeker suits larger parties seeking more space and a flybridge.

faq.q: Which boat is cheaper to charter: Astondoa 40 or Sunseeker Predator 55?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 is significantly cheaper, starting at €749 for 2 hours, with all inclusions (skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, VAT). The Sunseeker Predator 55 is more expensive, with pricing available on request via WhatsApp. For budget-conscious groups, the Astondoa 40 is the clear winner.

faq.q: Can I charter the Sunseeker Predator 55 from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Yes, the Sunseeker Predator 55 departs from Puerto Banús, just like the Astondoa 40. Both boats are available for half-day or full-day charters along the Marbella coast, including stops at Cabopino, Estepona, or Cala del Faro.

faq.q: Which boat is better for a small group of 6–8 people?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 is ideal for groups of 6–8, as it accommodates up to 9 guests comfortably. The Sunseeker Predator 55 can take up to 12, but you'd pay for extra capacity you don't need. For a more intimate, cost-effective charter, choose the Astondoa 40.

faq.q: Does the Astondoa 40 have a flybridge?
faq.a: No, the Astondoa 40 is a sport cruiser without a flybridge. It features a spacious cockpit and sun pads. The Sunseeker Predator 55, by contrast, has a flybridge with additional seating and panoramic views, which is a key differentiator for those who want elevated outdoor space.

faq.q: What is included in the Astondoa 40 charter price?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 charter at €749 for 2 hours includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The Sunseeker Predator 55 includes the same, but at a higher price point.

faq.q: How do I book either boat?
faq.a: You can book the Astondoa 40 directly through our website, with transparent pricing starting at €749 for 2 hours. For the Sunseeker Predator 55, pricing is on request—contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. Both boats are available for charter from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Which boat offers better value for a full-day charter?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 offers excellent value at €2,299 for an 8-hour charter, including all amenities. The Sunseeker Predator 55, while more luxurious and spacious, costs significantly more. For a full day exploring Marbella's coastline, the Astondoa 40 provides a premium experience without the premium price tag.

data.body_html:
Choosing between the Astondoa 40 and the Sunseeker Predator 55 for your Marbella charter? Both depart from Puerto Banús, but they cater to different budgets and group sizes. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) starts at €749 for 2 hours, while the Sunseeker Predator 55 (16.8m, 12 pax) is larger and more expensive, with pricing on request. This guide breaks down the key differences to help you decide which boat suits your Marbella day out.

Astondoa 40 vs Sunseeker Predator 55: Key Specs at a Glance

FeatureAstondoa 40Sunseeker Predator 55
Length12.5 m16.8 m
Max Guests9 pax12 pax
DeparturePuerto BanúsPuerto Banús
Starting Price (2h)€749On request
Full-Day Price (8h)€2,299On request
FlybridgeNoYes
InclusionsSkipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, VATSkipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, VAT

Both boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The Astondoa 40 is a sport cruiser, while the Sunseeker Predator 55 offers a flybridge for elevated lounging.

Why Choose the Astondoa 40 for Your Marbella Charter?

The Astondoa 40 is a sleek, sporty cruiser perfect for smaller groups of up to 9 guests. At €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full day, it delivers exceptional value. You'll cruise from Puerto Banús past the Golden Mile, stop for a swim at Cala del Faro, or anchor off Cabopino. The open cockpit and sun pads make it ideal for sunbathing and socialising. For a cost-effective yet premium experience, the Astondoa 40 is hard to beat. Explore our full fleet of Marbella charter boats to see other options.

When the Sunseeker Predator 55 Makes Sense

The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a larger, more luxurious vessel with a flybridge, accommodating up to 12 guests. It's best for bigger parties, corporate events, or those who want panoramic views from the flybridge. Pricing is on request—contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. The extra length (16.8m) provides more deck space and a larger cabin. If you have a bigger budget and need room for a crowd, the Sunseeker Predator 55 is a solid choice.

Comparing Onboard Experience: Space and Comfort

The Astondoa 40 offers a cosy, intimate setting with a spacious cockpit and foredeck sun pads. The Sunseeker Predator 55, with its flybridge and larger interior, gives you more areas to spread out. For a romantic sunset cruise or a small family outing, the Astondoa 40 feels personal. For a lively party with friends, the Sunseeker's extra capacity and flybridge bar area win out. Both boats include drinks and snacks, so the main difference is space and price.

Which Boat is Best for Your Marbella Itinerary?

Both boats depart from Puerto Banús, giving you access to the same stunning coastline. Popular routes include heading west to Estepona or east to Cabopino. The Astondoa 40, being smaller, can nudge into tighter coves like Cala Cortés. The Sunseeker Predator 55, with its deeper draft, is better for open-water cruising. If you plan to anchor in shallow bays, the Astondoa 40 is more versatile. For a longer run to Sotogrande, the Sunseeker's extra speed and comfort shine.

Pricing Breakdown: Astondoa 40 vs Sunseeker Predator 55

  • Astondoa 40: €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. All-inclusive.
  • Sunseeker Predator 55: Pricing on request. Expect to pay significantly more per hour.

For a budget-conscious group, the Astondoa 40 is the clear winner. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a premium option for those who want the extra space and flybridge. Both include the same inclusions, so the choice comes down to group size and budget. Check out our Astondoa 40 charter page for more details.

Final Verdict: Which One Should You Charter?

If you have a group of 6–9 people and want a great value day out, go with the Astondoa 40. You'll get a premium experience for €749 for 2 hours, with all the trimmings. If you need room for 10–12 guests or specifically want a flybridge, the Sunseeker Predator 55 is worth the extra cost. Both boats offer the same high standard of service, drinks, and snacks.
